title: Pamaal Lasha Dekh ke
body:
Haye qasim
Haye qasim, haye qasim...haye qasim..(2)
<<MINI>>
Pamaal laasha dekh ke kehti hai bibiyaa'n..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Zahra ki tarha tooti hai qasim ki pasliyaa'n
<<MINI>>
Pamaal laasha dekh ke kehti hai bibiyaa'n..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Tukde pukare dasht mein labbayk ya Hussain..(2)
aakar kaha jo maula ne qasim ho tum kaha'n
<<MINI>>
Pamaal laasha dekh ke kehti hai bibiyaa'n..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Pamaal jiteji jo hua hai use salaam..(2)
rokar lahu ye kehte hai khud sahib az-zamaa'n
<<MINI>>
Pamaal laasha dekh ke kehti hai bibiyaa'n..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Aajao mere bhai talak bole ye hasan..(2)
qasim na lo hussain ki ghubat ka imtehaa'n
<<MINI>>
Pamaal laasha dekh ke kehti hai bibiyaa'n..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ye kehke kuch nishano ko sheh chumne lage..(2)
abbas dekhko ragdi hai qasim ne aydiya'n
<<MINI>>
Pamaal laasha dekh ke kehti hai bibiyaa'n..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Tukde uthane laash ke sarwar ke saath saath..(2)
zahra gayi hai dasht mein jaane kaha'n kaha'n
<<MINI>>
Pamaal laasha dekh ke kehti hai bibiyaa'n..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Pamaal ho na laash chacha ki ye soch kar..(2)
lipta hua sumo se hai farwa ka naujawa'n
<<MINI>>
Pamaal laasha dekh ke kehti hai bibiyaa'n..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Madar karegi kis tarha deedar aakhri..(2)
haye sumo ke chand se chehre pe hai nishaa'n
<<MINI>>
Pamaal laasha dekh ke kehti hai bibiyaa'n..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Lagta hai mujhko 'mir takallum' khayaam se..(2)
ab bhi sunayi deti hai farwa ki hichkiya'n
<<MINI>>
Pamaal laasha dekh ke kehti hai bibiyaa'n..(2)
